ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite will be enforced. This section will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 20, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This section will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering students on Monday, May 4, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 3 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 28, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m.
